insight: Built around cross-app automations that fire from meeting content — assigning action items, updating CRM, triggering Zapier — beyond notes.
name: Circleback
tagline: AI meeting notes and action items that trigger cross-app automations.
description: Circleback generates organized meeting notes and captures action items with automatic assignment, transcribing across 100+ languages with speaker identification. It connects to 20+ tools like Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Linear, and Notion to run automations off what was said in a meeting.
